$$

&=\frac{e^{- x y}\left(- x^{2} y + x\right)}{\left(x y - 2\right)^2}.
\end{aligned}
$$

&=x\cdot \left(- \frac{1}{y^{2}}\right) \\
&=- \frac{x}{y^{2}}\end{aligned}
$$

Combining the terms,

$$
\begin{aligned}f_{y}(x,y) &=\frac{x}{y}+\ln{\left(x \right)} \\ &\quad +e^{2 x + y}- \frac{x}{y^{2}}.\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂}{∂x}(- y^{2} \ln{\left(x \right)}) &=- y^{2}\cdot \frac{∂}{∂x}(\ln{\left(x \right)}) \\

$$

question.:question/problem: Find $f_{y}(x,y)$ for $f(x,y)=2 x \ln{\left(y \right)}+y \ln{\left(x \right)}+e^{2 x + y}+\frac{x}{y}$, where $x>0$ and $y>0$.

Differentiate with respect to $y$, treating $x$ as constant. First write $e^{2 x + y}=e^{2 x}\cdot e^{y}$ to expose the held exponential factor. Write reciprocal powers as negative powers, using $\frac{1}{y^n}=y^{-n}$ for positive $n$. The logarithm of the held variable is a constant multiplier. \begin{aligned}\frac{∂}{∂y}(2 x \ln{\left(y \right)}) &=2 x\cdot \frac{∂}{∂y}(\ln{\left(y \right)}) \\
&=2 x\cdot \left(\frac{1}{y}\right) \\
&=\frac{2 x}{y}\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂}{∂y}(y \ln{\left(x \right)}) &=\ln{\left(x \right)}\cdot \frac{∂}{∂y}(y) \\
&=\ln{\left(x \right)}\cdot \left(1\right) \\
&=\ln{\left(x \right)}\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂}{∂y}(e^{2 x + y}) &=e^{2 x}\cdot \frac{∂}{∂y}(e^{y}) \\
&=e^{2 x}\cdot \left(e^{y}\right) \\
&=e^{2 x + y}\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂}{∂y}\left(\frac{x}{y}\right) &=x\cdot \frac{∂}{∂y}\left(\frac{1}{y}\right) \\
&=x\cdot \left(- \frac{1}{y^{2}}\right) \\
&=- \frac{x}{y^{2}}\end{aligned}
$$

Combining the terms,

$$
\begin{aligned}f_{y}(x,y) &=\frac{2 x}{y}+\ln{\left(x \right)} \\ &\quad +e^{2 x + y}- \frac{x}{y^{2}}.\end{aligned}

question.:question/problem: Find $f_{x}(x,y)$ for $f(x,y)=- 3 x^{4} \sin{\left(y \right)}+2 x \arctan{\left(y \right)}- \frac{2 x^{2}}{y^{4}}$, where $y\ne0$.

$$

&=- \frac{4 x}{y^{4}}\end{aligned}

$$
